name: mnemo
description: Shared memory for your coding agents, in one encrypted file
long_description: MNemo keeps what your coding agents learn in one encrypted `.mnemo` file: every session's turns, facts that keep their history, and a project essence, searched by meaning and keywords together. Several sessions coordinate through the same file with a task queue, an inbox, claims and review findings. This bundle runs `mnemo serve --mcp --shared` on the brain you choose, so other sessions and the `mnemo` CLI can use it at the same time. Create the brain first with `mnemo onboard` (in a repository) or `mnemo init`.

brain.title: Brain
brain.description: The .mnemo file to serve, on a local disk (shared mode refuses network and synced folders). Create it first with `mnemo onboard` or `mnemo init`.

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: The brain's passphrase. Leave it empty when the brain's key is in the system keychain, as `mnemo onboard` sets it up.
